policy: Production advisories of high or critical severity always fail. Dev-only high/critical advisories fail unless listed here with a future reviewBy date. Moderate and low advisories are reported only.

risks.reason: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs in picomatch <=4.0.7. The latest published picomatch is 4.0.7 and vite/vitest require ^4.0.7, so no fixed release exists (checked 2026-11-18). npm audit's suggested fix is a major downgrade of vitest/vite.
risks.mitigation: Dev and test tooling only: not shipped to browsers or production servers, and glob patterns come from repository configuration, not user input.
